meta.title: Paired expansion and reverse reconstruction
meta.summary: Five of six Round19 loop gates are accepted: boundary-consistent clipped clusters, a direct product representation, the complete 48-channel two-cube projector with exact cross Gram, a finite two-cube continuous signed-box spectral certificate, and the finite static U-V-W chain integral/common-V discriminator. C2 is running under an actual continuous static-κ interval contract. Parent dense/homogeneous stability, finite-restriction convergence, continuum construction, spectral gap theorem, physical energy/time-scale matching and physical Fibonacci significance remain open.

geometry_hypothesis.title: Double Fibonacci-style golden-spiral work discipline
geometry_hypothesis.claim: The two opposing Fibonacci-style golden/log spirals are an organization-only formula for paired expansion nodes: the forward derivation expands a candidate construction, while the reverse reconstruction asks which premises the target statement would require.
geometry_hypothesis.limit: The SVG uses an approximate logarithmic/golden spiral formula, not exact Fibonacci arcs. No physical test of the geometry has been performed in Round19; its physical role remains an untested hypothesis. Each scientific loop must pass by graph, Haar, min-max, source-bound, and independent comparison checks.

review.summary: A1, A2, B1, B2 and C1 are accepted within their declared finite/product/static scopes. C2 is running under an actual continuous static-κ interval contract. No physical energy/time-scale match is accepted.
limits: The double-spiral geometry is a hypothesis and work organizer, not physical evidence.
A2 is a direct product-representation theorem, not finite clipped-restriction convergence or homogeneous dense stability.
B1 and B2 are finite two-cube spectral results; they do not prove the dense limiting spectral passage or continuum Yang-Mills.
C1 is a finite static integral with all other links fixed; it does not prove a spectral gap theorem or physical Hamiltonian/time matching.
Static κ is a coefficient for Euclidean integrals, not a regulator, Hamiltonian time match, or physical energy scale.
No current Round19 file proves a continuum Yang-Mills construction, finite-restriction convergence to the A2 representation, or Clay mass gap.
